about: What the app writes to the first mate when the captain answers a call, as src-tauri/src/review.rs writes it. Its tests build each message and compare it with this file, and scripts/calls.test.mjs reads each back with answerOfMessage, so the two ends cannot drift apart.

answered.label: Keep merging once checks pass
answered.text:
The captain answered a call from Bearings.
Answers already recorded with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh; do the follow-up each one calls for, and do not record them again:
Recorded: foreman-auto-merge = keep ("Keep merging once checks pass")

answered.label: Wi-Fi only, with "visible" progress
answered.note: Revisit when I'm back on Monday.
answered.text:
The captain answered a call from Bearings.
Answers already recorded with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh; do the follow-up each one calls for, and do not record them again:
Recorded: res-model-download = wifi-only ("Wi-Fi only, with "visible" progress")
The captain added: Revisit when I'm back on Monday.

replied.words: Pause it, and tell the user why.
replied.text:
The captain replied to call res-wifi-drop from Bearings, in words; it is kept on the call as the captain's reply, and nothing has recorded it.
Record one with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh answer only if the captain's words decide the call (with --key when they name one of its options, and --via quarterdeck); otherwise answer the captain and ask again with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh offer, or hold it with --until when the words put it off to a date. Never infer an answer from the words alone.
The captain said: Pause it, and tell the user why.

replied.words: Not now. Ask me again on Oct 3. I want to see the battery numbers first.
